selection.name: Claude Code (C02)
selection.role: Complementary native Claude-account client with its own tools, model choices and resumable sessions. Its distributed runtime is commercially licensed.

basis.shows: Documents the native terminal coding client and recommended Linux/macOS installer; npm installation is deprecated.
Documents Claude.ai authentication, model selection, MCP tools, WebFetch/WebSearch, max-turn limits, resumed sessions and WSL-specific fixes.
Latest release published October 1, 2026. Repository is unarchived; observed default-branch commit 52c7644 was also October 1.

Successful public security-settings check. This is not evidence that the coding runtime passed functional tests; runtime source/tests were not found in the inspected public tree and release-tag check contexts.
Commercial terms and reserved rights. Selection follows the frozen license-is-informational rule; this runtime is not described as open source.

It is unarchived with a September documentation commit, so the stale criterion does not apply. layers.deciding_comparison: The native pair has the clearest documented account/client fit, but comparative performance is unresolved. If a concrete missing event, tool or recovery requirement emerges, compare the affected native client with its supported SDK on WSL2 using identical account, model, task, permissions and expected effects. Measure event completeness, tool effects, bounded termination, resume after process interruption, lost/duplicated effects, task completion, latency and cost. Admit alternative clients only after verifying the same account/model path; different underlying models would confound repository quality.
evidence_gaps: No comparison is recorded in the packet, and no matched public coding/research benchmark was verified in the consulted upstream sources. Selection asserts documented fit, not measured superiority.
Claude Code supplies native Claude-account coverage, but its commercial runtime and limited inspected public test evidence qualify the request's open-source wording; license was kept informational.

All nine resolved repositories were unarchived and had default-branch commits within July 3–October 1, 2026, New York time. Latest releases were also within that window except retired Letta V1's May 14 release. October 2 UTC observations occurred October 1 locally.

Linux documentation/builds support the WSL2 fit inference; no target-host head-to-head was run. Codex macOS arm64 release builds were verified; Claude Code arm64-specific support was not established in the inspected sources. The requirement does not activate a GPU workload.
Recent issues were sampled through the API, establishing activity but not comparative maintainer responsiveness. CI check counts are not test-case counts or task-quality scores.
The unspecified eight-project bundle remains unevaluated; it was not classified as stale, unsupported or paid-only.
